session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trend Reversal, then TR' (filename: big gap up and wedge opening reversal up from EMA). Spans 8/28 13:00 through the 8/30 edge marker (plain-PT). Reading: big gap up open (~2923) reversed down in an early sell-off to the 2905.5 low (07:45), where the wedge bull flag / 50% PB to MA setup flipped the day up; a bull micro channel and streaking breakout above the open high drove to 2926.5 by 09:10, the pink bull channel line ran to the 2930 top at 11:20 despite the caution note 'After big early selloff, unlikely to get far above H of open', and the rest of the day printed a trading range (2917-2928) with a magenta bear flag chop into the 2922 close.
